Description

Story Pack 2: FL4K and the Last Resort is part of the new Story Pack 2* content and can be purchased individually (base game required). The new Vault Hunter Loveless, the Hacker is available for separate purchase; to get all the Story Pack 2 content, purchase the Story Pack 2 Combo.

Welcome to the jungle, where a tropical resort made for the Timekeeper's chosen is about to become a warzone. Team up with FL4K, an unequaled beastmaster who lives for The Hunt, to save their loyal skag companion Mr. Chew and teach the Tediore corporation a brutal lesson about primal nature.

On the remote island of Providence, upper-crust Electi once vacationed in a luxurious retreat neighboring lush wilderness and a majestic volcano. In a ploy to secure Providence's precious Ordonite resource, Tediore has sent an expeditionary group led by five elite generals who serve the ruthless Lieutenant Harmony.

Venture into the verdant wilds and aid FL4K and their pet in the urgent fight against Tediore. Hunt down the generals however you see fit and show them that Vault Hunters can never be tamed.


New Content:
• New map zone, Providence, packed with new story missions, side missions, activities, and collectibles
• 8 story bosses (including a new major boss) and an additional 13 minibosses who can drop two new Pearlescent weapons, 18 pieces of new Legendary gear, and 6 new Legendary Class Mods
• Battle the footsoldiers and exoskeleton-mech operators of Tediore's Invasion Force army, led by the relentless Lt. Harmony, who can call in digistructed reinforcements (including guns with legs)
• Traverse high above the treetops of Providence's jungle by grappling onto ziplines that help you explore and get the upper hand in combat
• New cosmetic items including:
- 2 Vault Hunter Heads usable by all Vault Hunters
- 4 Vault Hunter Skins usable by all Vault Hunters
- 6 Weapon Skins
- 4 Vehicle Skins
- 3 ECHO-4 Drone Skins & Attachments
- 1 ECHO-4 Frame

This content is recommended for Vault Hunters of level 13+. In order to access the Providence island, you'll first need to complete the "A Lot to Process" mission in the Fadefields. You can also roll a new Vault Hunter that starts directly at the FL4K and the Last Resort content at level 13.

*FL4K and the Last Resort is the second of two post-launch DLC Story Packs coming to Borderlands 4. This content is included with Borderlands 4 Super Deluxe Edition and the Borderlands 4 Vault Hunter Pack, and is also available for separate purchase. Base game required.
